local_clone: /tmp/vivsim_src (git rev-parse HEAD succeeds on this clone)
shim: import lines only: jax/jax.numpy -> oss_ref.np_jax_shim; bodies verified byte-identical after stripping import lines (see bodies_identical_ex_imports)

oss_conventions.stencil: tensor product: offsets arange(-radius+1, radius+1) added to floor(marker), 1-D kernel evaluated per axis and multiplied; size 4**d for radius 2
oss_conventions.interpolate: einsum('ms,cms->mc') on .at-style gather of a flattened (n_components, nx*ny) grid
oss_conventions.spread: jnp .at[:, idx].add(values) -- unbuffered scatter-add, so overlapping markers accumulate
oss_conventions.mdf: step = (U_target - u_marker) * (2 * ds); u_marker += 0.5 * interp(spread(step)); converged force = 2 A^{-1} r0, A = interp.spread
oss_conventions.ds: get_ds = half of the two adjacent segment lengths (preconditioner only)
oss_conventions.kernels: peskin_4pt (support 2, two branches), peskin_3pt, cosine_4pt (separate kernel, sums to 1 over integers)
